claims: The Artemis II mission splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, specifically 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission splashed down on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The crew of the Artemis II mission landed safely.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day mission around the moon.
The recovery team from the U.S. Navy was prepared to retrieve the capsule of the Artemis II mission.
The capsule and crew of the Artemis II mission were recovered by the Navy.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed Artemis mission.
